description: This file defines the Jsonifiable interface and its nested interfaces, which specify how objects can be converted to JSON with various customization options such as schema version, predicates, pointers, and field selectors. It provides a flexible framework for JSON serialization within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Jsonifiable
classes.description: An interface representing entities that can be serialized to JSON, supporting multiple schema versions and various serialization options.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithPredicate
classes.description: A nested interface allowing JSON serialization with a predicate to filter content based on custom criteria.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithPointer
classes.description: A nested interface allowing JSON serialization with a specific JSON pointer to select content.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithFieldSelector
classes.description: A nested interface allowing JSON serialization with a field selector to determine included fields.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithFieldSelectorAndPredicate
classes.description: A nested interface combining field selection and predicate-based filtering for JSON serialization.

methods.name: getLatestSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the most recent supported JsonSchemaVersion.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns all supported JsonSchemaVersions; defaults to V_1 and V_2.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by the instance, defaults to latest.

methods.name: implementsSchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks if a specific schema version or integer is supported.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to a JsonValue.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the object.
